title: Briefing Lane: Runtime Weekly Check-in — Omar scratchpad
content:
Purpose: Quick prep notes for the Thursday runtime team sync (30m). This is my scratchpad — lean, prioritized; bring up only what affects the next 7 days. Keep meeting under 30 minutes.

Context snapshot (one-liners to read at start):
- P99 generation latency for small-chat model (v1.2.0) slipped from 210ms -> 320ms in EU region after the scheduler change last Tuesday. Incident was transient but reappeared on Tuesday morning for a short window.
- Canary rollout of prefetch-kv cache (canary-5) is at 15% traffic, showing ~8% token-cost reduction for baseline prompt set, but ~0.6% token-accuracy regression on eval set B (low-confidence).
- Autoscaler bump policy (policy-alpha) is reducing cold-starts but increasing mid-queue wait for medium-length sequences; need to inspect batching thresholds.

Metrics to surface (quick bullets, bring numbers):
- P50/P95/P99 (last 24h, EU): 78ms / 154ms / 320ms (target P99 <= 250ms).
- Cost per 1M tokens (hosted): $6.32 last 7d vs baseline $6.68 (-5.4%).
- Canary perf (canary-5): throughput +4.2%, token-cost -8.1%, eval-B BLEU -0.6
- Error rate spikes: 2026-03-11 09:12 UTC — spike to 1.8% (from 0.2%) for 6m window; traced to grpc connection resets from node pool g-eu-22.

Open questions I want to raise (fast):
1) Do we pause canary-5 and widen eval sets immediately, or let it complete to 25% and gather more signals? My default: pause, expand eval set + manual sampling.
2) Short-term mitigations for P99 regression: revert scheduler change or tweak per-tenant queue capacity? Which is lower risk?
3) Autoscaler: bump down batch_hold_ms from 12 -> 8 and measure latency — quick A/B?

Agenda (Timeboxed):
- 0:00–0:03 — Quick status (me): metrics + recent spikes (why it matters)
- 0:03–0:08 — Canary update (Lena): results, suggested action (pause/continue)
- 0:08–0:14 — Scheduler/Azure node reset root cause (Arjun): logs summary + quick mitigation options
- 0:14–0:21 — Autoscale batching tweak proposal (Maya): proposal + immediate experiment plan
- 0:21–0:27 — Action item assignment + owners confirm
- 0:27–0:30 — Parking lot / quick sync on blockers

Notes-to-self / speaking bullets:
- Emphasize customer impact (latency -> interactive apps degrade, page reloads, unhappy PLG cohorts).
- If asked about rollback risk: note rollback is trivial for scheduler (flip flag), but risk is capacity churn — we must notify SRE channel before rollback.
- For canary: call out specific prompts in eval-B that show hallucination; bring two samples to demonstrate severity.

Draft decisions I expect to propose:
- Pause canary-5 at 15% until expanded eval set + 100 manual samples flagged by QA. (Owner: Lena; ETA: 2026-03-14 EOD)
- Create short-lived scheduler-rollback runbook and coordinate with SRE (Owner: Arjun; ETA: 2026-03-12 noon).
- Launch autoscale micro-experiment (batch_hold_ms=8) on a 5% traffic bucket in us-west for 24 hours. Collect p50/p95/p99 + throughput. (Owner: Maya; ETA: start 2026-03-13)

Action items (clear, single-line, owner, due):
- [ ] Lena — pause canary-5 + snapshot traffic + add eval prompts to confluence (due 2026-03-14)
- [ ] Arjun — draft rollback runbook + post in #rt-incident (due 2026-03-12 12:00)
- [ ] Maya — deploy autoscale micro-experiment on 5% traffic, collect metrics (due 2026-03-13 18:00)
- [ ] Omar (me) — compile 10 worst-performing sample traces and share with SRE + QA (due 2026-03-12 16:00)
- [ ] SRE (cc: Rowan) — hold a 15m window for scheduled rollback, confirm available operators (requested by 2026-03-12 10:00)

Parking lot / issues to not bury in meeting:
- Investigate grpc client library bump (v1.8.0 -> v1.8.1) correlation with connection resets.
- Follow up on console dashboard: add live annotation for canary flags (owner: console team; ping: Lina).
- Longer-term: evaluate tuned-quantization profile c1 for small-chat (perf vs quality tradeoffs).

Prep checklist (what to bring into meeting):
- Short graf with the numbers above (I will paste into Slack pre-meeting).
- Two eval-B prompt examples that show hallucination — screenshots + raw outputs.
- Link to canary metrics dashboard + perf diffs (JIRA-RT-4821).
- Link to current autoscaler policy config (PR 823).

Post-meeting follow-up (template I will use in #rt-weekly after meeting):
- 1-line summary decision + list of action owners + deadlines. Pin the pause decision for canary if approved.
- Add meeting notes to Confluence under RT/weekly/2026-03-12.

Random scratch reminders (personal):
- Ping product about user impact notes for PLG demo accounts — we might need to ship a note to CS if rollback occurs.
- Update my personal dashboard to show per-tenant p99 instead of aggregated p99 (ongoing).

End of scratchpad. If this becomes 'final' I'll tidy language and move to shared_drives/product/rt/notes. For now: rapid, messy, actionable.
